en.headline: Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force as temperatures dip overnight
en.dek: The Observatory said the warning issued on Monday continues with extreme fire risk while urban readings hovered around 18 degrees early Wednesday and some New Territories spots fell lower.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Red Fire Danger Warning remained in force on Wednesday morning, indicating extreme fire risk. The warning was issued at 6.10am on Monday and has continued as relative humidity stays low.

At about 7am the Observatory recorded 18 degrees Celsius with relative humidity at 58 per cent. Conditions were sunny and dry. Some New Territories locations saw sharper overnight drops because of clear skies and lighter winds, with readings as low as around 11 degrees in places such as Ta Kwu Ling.

The Observatory forecast sunny and dry weather through the day, with a daytime high of about 25 degrees and moderate north to northeasterly winds. Later in the week temperatures are expected to rise, with a few showers possible by Friday.
Residents were reminded to take extra care with fire precautions while the warning is in effect.

zh.headline: 紅色火災危險警告持續 今早市區約18度新界更低
zh.dek: 天文台指警告自周一發出後仍然生效，火災危險性極高；今早市區約18度，新界部分地區輻射冷卻降至約11度。
body: 香港天文台表示，紅色火災危險警告周三早上仍然生效，顯示火災危險性極高。警告於周一上午六時十分發出，相對濕度持續偏低。
約上午七時，天文台錄得氣溫18度，相對濕度58%。天色晴朗乾燥。新界部分地區因天朗氣清及風勢較弱，夜間輻射冷卻明顯，打鼓嶺一帶低至約11度。
天文台預測今日天晴乾燥，日間最高約25度，吹和緩北至東北風。本周後期氣溫回升，周五起或有幾陣驟雨。
市民在警告生效期間須特別注意防火。
